rule_extra: Firm PAC and named officers are separate rows. BlackRock PAC is not Larry Fink. Larry Fink is not CNN.

records.summary: BlackRock does not spend corporate treasury on federal candidates. BlackRock PAC (employee-funded) plus employees totaled about $2.60M in the 2024 cycle (PAC $1.11M, individuals $1.47M), ~65/35 D/R. This is the firm, not Larry Fink and not CNN.

records.amount_label: candidate max-outs, not Super PAC scale
records.summary: Fink's own 2023–24 itemized gifts are hard-money max-outs (Brown, Tester, Warner, Kaine, Jeffries and related victory funds; one GOP Financial Services member). Different checkbook from BlackRock PAC. Not attached to any newsroom.
Iger's visible 2023–24 federal activity in the seed is contributions into Disney PAC ($5,000 in Nov 2023 and Oct 2024). That is personal money into the company PAC, not ABC News spending.
